conventions.erpLocal: Affine inverse radial ray range, matched SfM radial targets
conventions.perspectiveLocal: Affine inverse pinhole camera-Z, matched SfM camera-Z targets; convert Z to radial using actual observed ray_z before world projection

perspective.confounders: Global vs local fits change parameter count; ERP-local and perspective-local use same calibration IDs and parameter count but different input projection and appropriate depth convention. No claim of a pure single-variable projection ablation.
perspective.scope: Feature reprojection control only. Dense multi-crop spherical fusion, seam/overlap calibration, new GS are NOT RUN.
